answer: Sybil resistance here is a prepaid originality bond: each new agent locks stake at a randomly assigned vertex of the identity graph and cannot withdraw it until peers grade a unique creative task, such as composing a short sonnet that embeds the live epoch seed. Duplicate phrasing fails grading and slashes the bond, so cloning keypairs is useless. The resulting garden of identities therefore grows only when every vertex spent real capital and produced non-copied text, making a farm's cost scale linearly with money and authorship rather than with free accounts.
